COMMODITYTEXT_LC_COMMODITY_427_HELP.before: The classmark required to change classes to ROGUE.
COMMODITYTEXT_LC_COMMODITY_427_HELP.after: Allows humans, faeries, gremlins and special characters to change to the Rogue class. Consumed on class change.

EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_508_HELP.before: Steal items from enemies. Success rate and variety of items that can be stolen increase with rank.
EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_508_HELP.after: Steal one random eligible equipped item. Weapons may be taken first. The enemy loses it. 25 MP.

EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_523_HELP.before: Inflict AIR AVERSE on all enemies within range. Chance of success increases with rank. Also grants WIND-TOUCHED to allies in the same area.
EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_523_HELP.after: Steal one equipped weapon. The enemy loses it. 40 MP.

EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_552_HELP.after: Steal Goth from an enemy. Stronger enemies carry more. Can succeed once per enemy per battle.

EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_554_HELP.before: Increase area of next spell cast by 3.
EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_554_HELP.after: Reveal hidden traps to your allies.

EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_607_HELP.before: Lay a trap in an adjacent tile. A tarot card is required to set traps.
EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_607_HELP.after: Lay a trap on an adjacent empty tile. It springs when an enemy steps on it.

EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_626_HELP.before: Disarm a trap in an adjacent tile.
EFFECTTEXT_LC_EFFECT_626_HELP.after: Remove a trap from an adjacent tile. You can target its location if you know where it was placed.
